Reviewed one-joint cranial source mapping, exact skin-digest recheck, 33 procedural checks, Sonic AttackS3S to Mario native/contact witness and private-desktop UI. Side-view and whole-mesh evidence retain unresolved head/hat clearance; no general quality acceptance.

Production 9913e6d plus a read-only acceptance witness: authentic Sonic AttackS3S to Mario native bake/reopen and root/support checks pass; 49 quarter-frame samples expose pre-serialization palm, forearm and aggregate trunk/body-surface errors. Isolated temporal trials improved hands but failed combined torso/skin quality; production hooks were reverted.

Generic own-limb hand/foot reserve and inner cancellation; 116 procedural checks, four authentic Mario/Snake DownStandU and LandingAirN native hand cases, Sonic-to-Mario cranial regression, and 25-check private-desktop review. Source-derived support and bind-sole clearance still require review; broad quality remains open.

Sonic AttackS3S to Mario early skinned hand/body quality explicitly fails despite native reopen; a failed generic palm IK trial was reverted. Read-only hand-pose warning and 29/29 private-desktop review checks pass. No motion correction accepted.

Six exact Sonic-to-Mario body/hand candidates: best reopened palm 0.141779, forearm 0.259013 and trunk 0.000021; hand/forearm and provisional shoulder-seam limits fail. One trial failed native translation validation. Only v6 has a retained source diff; all solver code was reverted.

28 procedural checks; 8-group, 12-time authentic cranial skin witness; synthetic Sonic exact-copy error zero; authentic Sonic-to-Mario safely refused; Link/Samus 430-sample support trajectory checks pass. No accepted Sonic-to-Mario output.

33/33 procedural, 94/94 coordinate and 32/32 branched-head checks; exact Sonic-to-Mario 474 trajectory and 345 supported-contact samples pass, but full-mesh HatN floor crossing reaches -3.79684 at frame 5. Overall unequal-rig quality remains failed/unverified.

Fresh baseline 49-quarter-frame witness: palm/forearm errors 0.43206/0.26132 and extra aggregate trunk/body-surface descent 1.9493 target units. Isolated native temporal candidate reached palm/forearm 0.047087/0.084355 but left the same 1.9493 trunk deficit and moved skin vertices up to 2.810823 units; no combined quality correction accepted.

A demonstrated pre-serialization hand-depth residual is corrected below the unchanged own-arm bound after native reopen. Four authentic cases and 116 procedural checks pass; Sonic-to-Mario head/hat and general contact quality remain unresolved.

Fresh exact Sonic-to-Mario quarter-frame hand/body gate fails: palm 0.432063 > 0.05 arm, forearm 0.261322 > 0.10 arm, trunk descent 1.949278 > 0.039408 target units. Reverted palm IK trial also failed combined bounds.

Exact Sonic donor snapshot and reviewed Sonic-to-Mario full-quality CHR0 freshly reopen; target content, roots, all represented weights and source/model ownership retain their bounded checks. No game-runtime or external-editor qualification.

Fresh restored production baseline baked 283,752-byte Sonic-to-Mario CHR0 and reopened exact fixture hash, passing existing trajectory, supported-contact and protected-root checks; witness adds no new quality pass gate.

DownStandU and LandingAirN in both Mario/Snake directions freshly reopen; withheld eighth-frame hand skin agrees with independent native MDL0 evaluation. Sonic AttackS3S to Mario also reopens with exact protected roots, 474 trajectory and 345 supported-contact samples.
Unchanged 283752-byte Sonic-to-Mario CHR0 freshly reopens, with 474 trajectory, 345 supported-contact, 129 withheld-fraction and exact protected-root checks. Hand/body quality separately fails.
Fresh private-desktop mapping/evidence captures pass; inspected 87-frame orthographic side comparison shows Mario head/hat/body crossing the bind-plane guide around frames 5–12.

Inspected native review captures and 117-frame Snake DownStandU to Mario orthographic side GIF. A white hand-shaped region crosses an unverified Y=0 guide near t15; neither floor nor broad whole-body clearance is accepted.

Fresh inspected Dense and source-key private-desktop review captures display hand warnings first; 29/29 UI checks pass. Existing Sonic side GIF remains historical because animation bytes did not change.

Reviewed Sonic AttackS3S to Mario now maps one source neck and reopens a native result, but a HatN-weighted target vertex and visible head/hat/body cross the bind-plane guide around frames 5–12. Supported contacts do not validate that whole-mesh interval or gameplay collision.

The exact Sonic donor snapshot with nonzero scaling rule now reopens; the earlier exact same-rig copy failure remains historical evidence for a different path. Private-desktop review and Use/import/Undo pass on the named fixture; physical human input and runtime remain unverified.
Single-cranial-joint review is source-side and session-only. Target-side merged head/neck and one-versus-two shoulder chain transfer still need reviewed topology composition and bidirectional tests.

Source-derived hand support is a proposal, not a reviewed planted contact. The accepted own-limb reserve fixes one measured hand-depth residual; the Sonic forward-tilt hand/body gate still fails. Six later isolated scalar-height and upper-arm reach trials also failed combined hand/forearm or native gates and were reverted; a separate body lift makes target hands hover, while earlier hand-only mapped-arm trials leave trunk and whole-skin quality unresolved. No independently qualified shoulder-seam acceptance bound exists.

Explicit reviewed neck-local cranial surface avoids quill-as-head mapping and duplicate neck FK. Sonic AttackS3S to Mario reopens and passes supported-contact checks; inspected side comparison and all-vertex witness show unresolved head/hat/body clearance.

Fresh restored baseline and read-only shoulder topology witness reopen unchanged. Experimental mapped-arm motion meets early hand bounds but fails trunk/full-skin quality, with up to 2.810823 same-target vertex shift and 1.182349 right shoulder-gap change; all production hooks were reverted.

Snake/Mario DownStandU and LandingAirN hand-support cases reopen within sampled own-arm bounds, with cancellation and a 25-check native UI review. Source-derived support and preview guide still require review; whole-body quality is open.

Authentic Sonic AttackS3S to Mario skinned palm, forearm and trunk gate fails despite fresh native reopen. Read-only warning passes 29/29 private-desktop checks; failed generic palm-height correction was reverted.

Five trial CHR0s reopen and retain protected roots, but every candidate fails hand/forearm quality and provisional seam diagnostics; one additional trial fails native validation before output. No production motion change.
Preview.96 exact-rig and changed-proportion named Brawl cases.
28 procedural checks, exact Sonic cranial branch witness at 12 times, safe unequal-rig refusal, and Link/Samus 430-sample trajectory oracles. No Sonic head/hand transfer pass.

33 virtual-cranial, 94 coordinate and 32 branched-head checks pass. Exact Sonic-to-Mario result passes 474 trajectory and 345 supported-contact samples, but all-vertex HatN clearance reaches -3.79684 native units at frame 5 against its bind-plane guide; source is also below its own guide. Broad nonidentical-rig quality fails to qualify.

Read-only baseline palm/forearm errors 0.43206/0.26132. Isolated v16 mapped-arm result meets early hand bounds 0.047087/0.084355 but retains 1.949278 trunk descent and shifts target skin up to 2.810823 units; no reviewed shoulder-seam bound or whole-body pass.
A pre-serialization hand-support error now passes the unchanged sampled own-arm bound after fresh CHR0 reopen; unrelated head/hat clearance remains unresolved.

Five isolated trial CHR0s reopened with unchanged roots/support but failed hand/forearm and provisional shoulder-seam measurements; a sixth was rejected by native translation validation. Trials were reverted.
Preview.96 exact-rig and changed-proportion named Brawl cases.
Authentic Link/Samus full-quality/default CHR0 results freshly reopened in both directions; Sonic-to-Mario has no output.

Reviewed Sonic-to-Mario 44-frame CHR0 freshly reopens with zero sampled world-bone, skin and supported-contact displacement from its same finished full-quality target; no external editor or game-runtime qualification.
Fresh restored baseline native bake and reopen produce the unchanged 283,752-byte output, with 474 trajectory and 345 supported-contact samples; this does not pass new hand/body quality.
Four directional DownStandU/LandingAirN outputs and Sonic AttackS3S to Mario freshly reopen with exact roots and sampled supported-contact checks.
Inspected 87-frame private-desktop orthographic side comparison shows the Mario head/hat/body crossing its bind-plane guide around frames 5–12; no visible quill-driven head spin.

25-check private-desktop review with native target captures and an inspected 117-frame Snake DownStandU to Mario side GIF; the t15 white extremity crosses the unverified guide, so clearance remains open.

limitations: The reviewed source-side Sonic one-joint cranial route produces a reopened target without mapping a quill as head, but full-mesh HatN/head/body clearance and actual floor/contact interpretation remain unresolved despite passing supported-contact samples.
The review is session-only and requires exact source rig/skin evidence; target-side merged head/neck, one-versus-two shoulder chains, broad anatomy and game runtime remain unqualified.
The source-derived hand-support correction is bounded to finite named fixtures and is not a reviewed Hand.* contact interval or proof of game-floor placement.

Sonic forward-tilt hand/body quarter-frame gate fails; the UI warning is diagnostic and the animation was not corrected. Six exact-fixture source-relative body/hand trials were rejected and reverted; scalar palm-height plus direct upper-arm translation does not preserve forearm and shoulder attachment quality.
capabilities.next_step: Develop an offline three-dimensional skinned palm/forearm and target-only shoulder-chain solve for pinned Sonic-to-Mario.
